reports.student_reply: Hey! The answer key is actually correct. When you combine the 64 drops, the total charge becomes 64 × 5 µC and the radius becomes 4 times larger (since volume is conserved). Surface density σ = Q/Area, so σ_big/σ_small = (64 q)/(4π(4r)^2) ÷ (q)/(4πr^2) = 64 · r^2/(16 r^2) = 4. Hence the ratio is 4:1, option B. The bigger drop does have more area, but it also has a lot more charge, giving a higher surface charge density.
